title: Green Israeli Couscous
subtitle: with zucchini, broccoli and pesto
description: Israeli couscous cooked in one pan with zucchini, broccoli, pesto and parmesan, finished with rocket and lemon zest.

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a wide frying pan. Add the sliced zucchini, broccoli florets and garlic and fry for about 5 minutes until lightly charred.
Add the pesto and mix well. Fry together for another 2 minutes.
Add the Israeli couscous, basil leaves, salt and chilli flakes (if using) and mix well.
Pour in 2 cups of boiling water, add the butter and stir.
Cook over medium-low heat for about 6 minutes.
Add the grated parmesan and stir until it melts into the couscous.

Add the rocket, the grated lemon zest and an extra half cup of water and keep cooking, stirring, until the couscous is tender (about 5 more minutes). If it is not tender enough, gradually add more boiling water as needed.
